versions.changelog:
- Initial release of wechat-use v0.1.0.
- Provides a unified CLI to send WeChat messages and query sessions, contacts, chat history, images, and favorites on macOS (Apple Silicon required).
- Adds a stable local HTTP/gRPC bridge for integration with agents and automation platforms.
- Supports direct recipient resolution, including fuzzy name matching and disambiguation with recent activity bias.
- Introduces efficient Stream/Event API for live message updates with filtering options.
- Requires WeChat 4.1.8/4.1.9, activation code, and one-time DB key extraction; no WeChat.app re-signing needed.
